text: Ko sirkuɓe ɓe kaalata ko, ko faati e innirde malaykaaji inɗe rewɓe, fotde ganndal mum en ko ɗoon haaɗi, sabu koɓe majjuɓe, ɓe ɓe njottaaki e yananeede, ko joom ma noon ɓuri anndude oon gooñiiɗo acci laawol peewal, ko Kanko ɓuri anndude kadi oon peewɗo e laawol makko he, alah fof ko wirnii e Makko hay huunde.
